name: False Doctrines
overview: Scripture warns believers against accepting false doctrines that invert truth and righteousness, as Isaiah 5:20 condemns those who call evil good and good evil. Jesus clearly declares Himself as the exclusive way to the Father, emphasizing the necessity of adhering to His truth (John 14:6). The early church faced threats from deceitful teachers described as grievous wolves who would seek to harm the flock (Acts 20:29), and Paul expresses astonishment at believers quickly turning away from the gospel of Christ to embrace another message (Galatians 1:6). Together, these passages highlight the danger of departing from the true gospel and the importance of steadfastness in Christ's revealed truth.
